user.title: Connect Mealie Atelier
user.description: Your API token stays in Home Assistant. This complements, not replaces, the built-in Mealie integration.

data_description.url: The full address Home Assistant can reach, including http:// or https:// and the port, for example http://192.168.1.20:9000. For the Mealie Home Assistant app, use port 9090. Do not use an ingress or login URL.
data_description.api_token: Create a token in Mealie under User profile > API Tokens, then paste it here. Home Assistant stores it securely. It must never go in card YAML.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this enabled. Disable it only for a self-signed certificate on a trusted local network.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Mealie Atelier
reauth_confirm.description: Mealie rejected the saved API token for {url}. Create a new token in Mealie under User profile > API Tokens and enter it here.

data_description.api_token: A new token for the same Mealie account. Find it in Mealie under User profile > API Tokens.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Mealie Atelier
reconfigure.description: Change the Mealie address or token. Home Assistant checks the connection before saving.

data_description.url: The full address Home Assistant can reach, including http:// or https:// and the port, for example http://192.168.1.20:9000. Do not use an ingress or login URL.
data_description.api_token: Create a token in Mealie under User profile > API Tokens, then paste it here. Home Assistant stores it securely.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this enabled. Disable it only for a self-signed certificate on a trusted local network.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the Mealie token.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http(s) Mealie URL, for example http://192.168.1.20:9000.
error.cannot_connect: Mealie is unreachable or returned an error.

abort.already_configured: This Mealie account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Mealie account. Use a token of the account that was set up.

init.title: Security and interaction
init.description: Control what the dashboard may change and which optional services it can use.

data_description.read_only: Blocks all changes to recipes, meal plans and shopping lists. Useful for shared tablets.
data_description.write_users: Leave empty to let every Home Assistant user change shopping lists and meal plans. Administrators can always write. Recipe editing stays admin only.
data_description.experimental_ingredient_edits: Lets administrators edit ingredients with linked foods and units. A backup is saved before every change.
data_description.usda_fdc_api_key: Optional. Free key from USDA FoodData Central, used for nutrition lookup.
data_description.openai_api_key: Optional. Only used for food search suggestions. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.timer_notify_service: Optional. A notify service such as notify.mobile_app_your_phone that receives a push message when a kitchen timer ends. Leave empty for in-app notifications only.

error.invalid_notify_service: Enter a notify service like notify.mobile_app_your_phone.

read_only.message: Mealie Atelier is in read-only mode.

unauthorized.message: Only Home Assistant administrators can do this.

write_not_permitted.message: Your Home Assistant user may not change data. An administrator can grant access in the Mealie Atelier options.

auth_failed.message: Mealie refused access. Check the API token and its permissions.

recipe_changed.message: The recipe changed since the preview. Reopen the analysis before continuing.

existing_values_protected.message: Existing values are protected. Confirm the replacement to continue.

timer_exists.message: A different kitchen timer with this ID already exists.

too_many_timers.message: There are too many kitchen timers.

timer_not_found.message: The kitchen timer was not found.

timer_not_permitted.message: You may not cancel another user's kitchen timer.

timer_dispatched.message: The kitchen timer has already been dispatched.

use_structured_editor.message: Edit ingredients with the structured ingredient editor. Plain-text replacement is no longer available.

write_unverified.message: Mealie accepted the change but the saved recipe differs. Backup {backup_id} can undo it.

backup_failed.message: The backup could not be saved, so nothing was changed. Check the free space and try again.

backup_not_found.message: This backup no longer exists. Open the version history again.

upload_invalid.message: The photo was refused. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most 10 MiB.

upload_expired.message: The upload expired. Choose the photo again.

upload_busy.message: Too many photo uploads are open. Wait a moment and try again.

disabled.message: Structured ingredient editing is switched off in the Mealie Atelier options.
